description: A platform-independent file lock for Python.

latest_release.body: ### Bug fixes - `UnixFileLock` refuses, with `PermissionError`, a lock file that another account owns under a sticky parent such as `/tmp`. Its owner could remove it during a hold, after which a second process locked a new file at the same path and both held the lock. A file owned by the directory's owner, such as `root` in `/tmp`, is still accepted ([#968](https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/pull/968)) by @gaborbernat. [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/filelock/4.2.12/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/compare/4.2.11...4.2.12)
